appropriate: a tilted seed with a curled stem and two tiny dot eyes reads as a small, quiet character and as a pip at once; soft and enclosing for Caregiver
distinctive: small eyes and the stem curl avoid the big-eyed cast of Khan Academy Kids, but a rounded blob mascot sits close to Reading Eggs' egg in silhouette
simple: one teardrop body, one curl, two dots; describable in one sentence
legible: the solid silhouette and stem hold at 16 px; the eyes merge away by 24 to 16 px; Pip reads cleanly beside it in every lockup
adaptable: black, reversed and one-colour 64/32 panels hold, and the app tile and avatar show a strong closed shape; the curl gives a natural wiggle for motion
timeless: a character where warmth is the strategy is on the trends Use list; no hexagon, sparkle or other avoid shape
universal: mirrored panel reads clean; rotated 90 it reads as a resting creature, and at 16 px the blob-with-curl hints faintly at a cartoon bomb with a fuse
clear: unsearched: seed and bean characters with dot eyes are common in kids' apps, and Pip and Tim's Pip and the Reading Eggs egg sit nearby in the category
congruent: round, one asymmetry, eyes well under a tenth of the body, mascot plus wordmark as targeted; the type weight is heavy and the wordmark capitalised rather than lowercase-led
system: horizontal lockup, symbol, small and favicon tiers all derive from one shape in the nav, tab, tile and card mockups
